text:
emma: Ok team — kicking off asia-west2 region onboarding for GPU capacity. Primary goals: 1) GitOps + Helm pipeline boot, 2) artifact replication to local registry mirror, 3) kube/taint/node validation for GPUs, 4) pre-warm images and run canary. Posting a compact checklist and run commands I used in staging.

raj: Nice. Do we have capacity target? how many p4d/p100 equiv nodes? :eyes:

emma: Target initial pool = 8 GPU nodes (mix p4d-equivalent for perf + a few cheaper gpus for cost). We’ll ramp after smoke tests.

luis: For registry, are we doing push-based replication or pull-mirror? Push was faster in prior regions.

emma: Push replication from central artifact registry -> asia-west2 mirror. Using signed images and cosign verification on nodes. We'll also set up ttl/garbage collection on mirror.

olivia: 👍 Can you paste the helm values snippet you want for gpu node groups and imagePullSecrets?

emma: Sure — added a minimal snippet the ops team used in staging:

```yaml
nodeGroups:
  gpu-pool:
    replicaCount: 8
    nodeSelector:
      accelerator: nvidia-t4
    taints:
      - key: gpu-only
        value: true
        effect: NoSchedule
    kubeletArgs:
      - "--feature-gates=DevicePlugins=true"
image:
  registry: asia-west2-mirror.internal.redwood
  imagePullSecrets:
    - name: reg-creds
```

raj: Looks good. For cosign we need the public key on the nodes before kubelets start pulling. Suggest a DaemonSet that drops `/etc/cosign/pubkey.pem`.

luis: Agreed. Also add a short `crane` prewarm job to pull heavy images during bootstrap. Example command we used: `crane cp gcr.io/redwood/model-server:sha256:abcd asia-west2-mirror.internal/redwood/model-server:sha256:abcd`

emma: Added that to the bootstrap job list. Also we must ensure the image registry accepts signed manifests.

infra-bot: NOTE: registry replication job scheduled: replication-job-asia-west2 at 03:15 UTC. Status: queued. :robot_face:

olivia: Network/cost note: push replication will incur egress from central region. We should compare egress vs cross-region storage cost. If egress spikes, consider using a peered bucket mirror in the target cloud provider.

emma: Good call. For now we have 1TB initial seeding estimate; egress should be ~20–30 USD one-time. I'll confirm with finance.

raj: What about GitOps pipeline — any special Helm repo auth or layout changes?

emma: Keep same repo layout but add `clusters/asia-west2/` overlay with values.yaml that include registry mirror. We'll add a `kustomize` patch for node taints and gpu labels. The pipeline (ArgoCD) will use a read-only service account with repo token scoped to that path.

luis: Remember imagePullPolicy: If we use pinned SHAs we set `imagePullPolicy: IfNotPresent` on nodes to reduce registry hits. For rollout canaries, use `imagePullPolicy: Always` for the canary deployment only.

olivia: Validation checklist idea: 1) Node labels present, 2) cosign verification DaemonSet running, 3) `kubectl describe pod` shows `imagePullSecrets` used, 4) run perf microbench (latency P99 on a simple generate request), 5) GPU utilization sanity.

emma: I'll create a short smoke test script. Example commands to check registry + cosign:

```
# verify cosign signature
cosign verify --key /etc/cosign/pubkey.pem asia-west2-mirror.internal/redwood/model-server:sha256:abcd
# quick pull test on node
ssh gpu-node-01 -- docker pull asia-west2-mirror.internal/redwood/model-server:sha256:abcd
```

infra-bot: DEPLOY: argo-app/asia-west2-gitops started by emma at 1887654400. Status: applying manifests.

raj: Will watch Argo sync. If it stalls, check the Helm repository auth token TTL — had one expire last time.

luis: Also add firewall rule for the nodepool to allow NTP, image registry CIDRs, and our monitoring ingestion endpoints. Don't open 0.0.0.0/0 to the cluster.

emma: Noted — NTP, registry, metrics endpoints only. I'll post the firewall rules in the runbook.

olivia: Who's owning the handoff to oncall once canary is green?

emma: Raj will do initial handoff and open a short runbook entry for SRE oncall to watch P99, error rate, and image pull errors for the first 48 hours.

raj: On it. I'll join the canary verification at +1h and then handoff.

luis: One more cost thing — GPU spot vs on-demand mix? We should provision 2 reserved + 6 spot for initial ramp, fallback to on-demand if we lose spot capacity. Add policy in the autoscaler config.

emma: Added autoscaler policy note in the gitops overlay.

infra-bot: CHECK: smoke-tests/asia-west2 started at 1887654700. Expected duration ~30m.

olivia: Thanks all — current next steps: emma finishes runbook snippets, infra-bot completes replication, argo finishes sync, raj runs canary. Ping here when each step completes. :thumbsup:
